name: pe-sieve
description: Scans a given process. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/injected PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: ShellStream
description: Execute shellcode from a remote server.

name: reverse_shell
description: A shellcode written in MASM assembly that connects to a server through TCP, creates a cmd.exe instance on the target machine and A shellcode written in MASM assembly that connects to a server through TCP, creates a cmd.exe instance on the target machine and redirects it's streams to the socket, so the server side has a shell of the machine.

name: Shellcode-Downloader-CreateThread-Execution
description: This POC gives you the possibility to compile a .exe to completely avoid statically detection by AV/EPP/EDR of your C2-shellcode and download and execute your C2-shellcode which is hosted on your (C2)-webserver.

name: Direct-Syscalls-A-journey-from-high-to-low
description: Start with shellcode execution using Windows APIs (high level), move on to native APIs (medium level) and finally to direct syscalls (low level).
